facts.fact: The BNA publishes a ranking of complaints in the Angolan financial system, recording 10,707 complaints in Q2 2025.
The BNA ranking puts Afrimoney at 1,138 complaints in Q2 2025, up 180.2% on Q1, with Unitelmoney at 935 and Paypay at 453.
The Banco Nacional de Angola's report on complaints in the Angolan financial system counts 16,548 complaints in Q1 2024, including complaints about mobile banking at non-bank institutions.
The BNA report puts Afrimoney at 8,453 mobile banking complaints in Q1 2024, with Unitel Money at 532 and PayPay at 110 among non-bank financial institutions.
